name: Kenneth J. Wolfe
current_role: Director, Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (since May 2026); Director, Center for Faith
summary: Kenneth J. Wolfe became director of the Labor Department’s much-reduced federal contractor watchdog, the Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs, in early May 2026 after Ashley Romanias left, its second director to depart. He also directs the department’s Center for Faith, a post he has held since June 2025, after a career at HHS’s Administration for Children and Families.
